summary: FAIL. Live re-measures on a fresh catalog confirm the round's main fixes: recall fills the 7 s channel on all five named fighters, Marund's Domefall leaves the ground to hips 1.57 m with the maul overhead and a landing crouch, Lamplit is a modelled deluxe, and all 24 GLBs load. Marund and Rishal reach 7.5; 7 of 8 are at par. Three things hold the wave: Ilsheta's new hollow black eyes read as a menacing mask on the icon and portraits (sensitivity blocker, score 7.2); her First Bell portrait has a black bar under the chin; and the Tunlan base splash has a floating black shadow with the face, not the lantern, as key. Dunsom's lobby idle also has an unreported 0.41 m hand pop (pre-existing).

items.evidence: Viewed art/out/fighters/ilsheta/icon.png at 128 and 600 px, plus portrait.png and ilsheta_first_bell_portrait.png (_harness/_shots/fw_CW6_r2v1_ilsheta_rear.png, fw_CW6_r2v1_small.png, fw_CW6_r2v1_ils_before_after.png). The f6621d17 face paint fixes the scattered rings, but the result is a long pale plate with two solid black almond voids, no glint or inlay, with grey smudges under them. On the icon's black and neon-green ground it reads as a hollow-eyed alien or ghost mask. This is my judgement as the sensitivity reviewer the engineer asked for. Ruling 2 says the same of Odrum: hollow eye slits on a mask read 'blank or menacing at portrait size' and lit, warm inlays keep the face alive. It is not a new shape problem: rear views are blunt and rounded (crown gate R3 11.6 cm, three skins) and pass ruling 7.
items.fixHint: art/blender/fighters/ilsheta.py face plate paint: replace the black voids with warm or lit inlays and a small cool glint (as Odrum Shadeprint and Hesmi), remove the grey smudges under the eyes, soften the plate edge. Re-render icon and all 3 portraits, then have a reviewer look at 26-128 px. Consider a warmer icon ground than black and neon green.

items.evidence: Hesmi GLB and cards unchanged since the earlier pass. Viewed all 6 cards (_harness/_shots/fw_CW6_r2v1_cards_hesmi.jpg) and icon and portrait at 128/64/26 px (fw_CW6_r2v1_small.png): two eyes with cool glints, no joint across the eye span, reads as alive. Facechip gate exit 0.

Idle head by FK (fw_CW6_v1_fk.mjs on current GLBs): Dunsom 6.6, Ilsheta 7.8, Marund 8.2, Rishal 4.8, Tunlan 7.2 cm, all >= 3.8. Seams 0.

Tunlan x_hat at 2x: cast_a1 0.188, cast_ult 0.210 m per 60 Hz frame (clip_steps, limit 0.3 exit 0). Marund in the real client, full 7 m cast: state dash, anim leap, clip domefall_leap, e.height peak 0.548 m, hips world y 0.419 -> 1.573 -> 0.482 m, crouch at landing (_harness/_reports/fw_CW6_r2v1_live.json). FK of the clip: at apex t 0.267 s hand.R 2.21 m against head 1.97 m, maul overhead; by t 0.6 s hand.R 0.51 m, the slam (fw_CW6_r2v1_apex.mjs). Sukri attacks and Mote Toss not re-measured: carried from verify 1; sukri.glb's only later rebuild is the recall and idle clips per its package.

Dunsom hat ramp mean 10.9, min 10.7 L* on three_dunsom.png of 00:19 (fw_CW6_hat_ramp.py). Odrum yoke vertical share 16.9 % (fw_CW6_odrum_yoke.mjs on the current GLB, modelled facings). Odrum cap, pale pixels in the live shot: median hue 35.0, sat 0.064 (coarse: the box also holds other pale parts); three sheet cap Lab 70.8 / -0.3 / 3.4 (_harness/_reports/fw_CW6_r2v1_gamecam_odrum.txt). Marund GLB unchanged since the maul pass. Hesmi stone/linen dE and Sukri wraps chroma and cup carried from verify 1: part_gamecam has no part map for hesmi or sukri here. Skin hat ramps: the script returns 0.0 on the Highrim and Almanac sheets (its mask does not fit them), so they are judged by eye only; the criterion names the base.

card_qa re-run: 48 cards, 0 misses (_harness/_reports/fw_CW6_r2v1_card_qa.txt). First Bell dE 29.3 >= 18. But the Tunlan criterion is not met: on art/out/fighters/tunlan/splash.png the top 0.01 % of pixels centre at x 0.723, y 0.310, the face; luma p99 in the lantern box 212.9 against 247.6 in the face box, so the lantern is not the key. The engineer disclosed this. The hound shadow is a large black streaked shape floating across the sky and spires, attached to no surface, and does not read as a hound; CW3c's r2 verify 2 also recorded it as reading as a fault. I viewed it and agree.
items.fixHint: Tunlan base splash: cast the shadow onto a real surface (the terrace wall or a near plate plane behind the figure), soften and lower it so the hound shape reads, and dim the face key about 15 % while raising the lantern emissive so the frame maximum sits on the lantern. Change only tunlan_splash staging.
